rules.rationale: This is the base equation of the splitSpaces recursive summary, defining the split of the empty string as the empty list.
This is a recurrence equation for splitSpaces: when the first character is a space, it defines the result by discarding that separator and recurring on the suffix.
This is a terminal equation for the splitSpaces summary, defining a nonempty string with no space as a singleton word list.
This is the word-producing recurrence of splitSpaces, defining the result as the prefix before the first space followed by recursively split remaining text.
This equation defines the named wordsContract summary by normalizing commas to spaces and applying splitSpaces.
